Expert Interview Transcript

Name:
Dr. Clara Alvarez

Role:
Head of Surgery

Market:
Northland

00:15 Interviewer:
"How would you describe current adoption of robotic surgery in your market?"

00:22 Dr. Alvarez:
"Adoption is growing, but it is concentrated in the larger university hospitals. Smaller regional hospitals are still mostly waiting."

01:05 Interviewer:
"What is holding adoption back?"

canvas
01:12 Dr. Alvarez:
"The biggest issue is still capital budget approval. Surgeons are enthusiastic, but the equipment committee moves slowly."

02:00 Interviewer:
"How important is ROI?"

02:08 Dr. Alvarez:
"Very important. The finance team wants to understand utilisation, procedure volume and maintenance cost before anything is signed."

03:10 Interviewer:
"What trend do you expect over the next 3–5 years?"

03:18 Dr. Alvarez:
"I would expect 15 to 20% more procedures each year in some of the stronger centres, not everywhere."

04:02 Interviewer:
"How long does a purchasing decision take?"

04:09 Dr. Alvarez:
"Usually 6 to 12 months from the first business case to signature."
